title: Phase-accumulating hyperfine strain sensing with rare-earth-ion phase memories
summary: Long-lived hyperfine coherences in rare-earth-ion crystals provide controlled phase evolution windows for metrology. We use this resource to propose an experimental protocol for accessing strain shifts of ground state hyperfine transitions in non-Kramers rare-earth-ion doped (REID) materials, a quantity that is difficult to access directly with conventional spectroscopic methods.
